name: SkateGM
tagline: Skate 3 in Garry's Mod: Skate 3's board physics, flick-it tricks and scoring on any map, with friends, minigames, a park editor and a skating gamemode.

games.label: Garry's Mod
games.engine: Garry's Mod (Source, x86-64 branch) + binary module gmcl_skategm_win64 (Rust, SK8-ENGINE) + Lua add-on

games.label: Skate 3 (Xbox 360)
games.engine: player's own Xbox 360 copy, converted on their PC (not installed into)

requires.note: Steam > Garry's Mod > Properties > Betas > x86-64: the module is 64-bit only
your own Skate 3 for Xbox 360: the disc image (.iso) or an extracted folder with default.xex; converted once on your PC, nothing from it is shipped
skating is controller only (Xbox, PlayStation, Switch Pro, ...); Steam Input off for Garry's Mod
for the one-time conversion with numpy and Pillow (pip install numpy Pillow); or use the author's SkateGM-Setup-6.0.exe instead

notes: How it works: you skate in Garry's Mod with Skate 3's board physics, flick-it tricks and scoring, on any map and with friends, plus minigames, a park editor, replays and a skating gamemode. Skate 3's data comes from your own copy, converted on your PC.

Once, before playing, convert your Skate 3: either run the author's SkateGM-Setup-6.0.exe (release page) and press Install, or with Python 3 run "pip install numpy Pillow" then "python <Garry's Mod>\garrysmod\lua\bin\exporter\convert.py --xex <your .iso or default.xex> --out C:/skategm".

Press Play, then pick the SkateGM gamemode, or in any gamemode type "bind j skategm_toggle" in the console once and press J (first start loads slowly). Controller only, Skate 3's controls; hold LB for extras: X respawn, B park editor, A settings, D-pad left minigames, RB replays.

You need Garry's Mod on Steam's x86-64 branch (Properties > Betas), Windows, a controller with Steam Input off for Garry's Mod (Properties > Controller), and your own Skate 3 for Xbox 360 (a disc image .iso you made, or a folder with default.xex).

Restore removes the add-on and module, not your converted data (C:/skategm, or %LOCALAPPDATA%\SkateGM\data with the setup): delete it yourself. In multiplayer every skater needs the mod and their own converted Skate 3. Some antivirus tools flag the module (a false positive, per the author).
Beta with open bugs (controller not detected after a crash, custom player models jitter, no option to turn off the airtime limit): report bugs to the author on the upstream issue tracker.
